authorization: The owner said "yes" to merging and releasing #564 (Convex first, then Vercel), after "continue" on the #540 follow-ups.

release.summary: Chapter painting waits out each refusal from the latest answer, with a budget per kind, so a rate-limit retry answered by a scene still preparing no longer pauses the job. Every 402 requeue and the daily-limit pause mark the request spent; Convex gives the verse its next request id only when that request ended failed (a refused hold whose withdrawal failed, or a refused final charge) and answers with the attempt, so a deferred retry or Resume no longer replays a recorded failure and ends the verse failed.
release.leftOut: The two refactors from #540 (split paintItem, gather the recovery refs) are #563.

steps.convex: Pushed to unique-impala-244 from d0078aa3. The only Convex change since the last push (700b289f) is bulkGenerations.updateVerseStatus answering a spent requeue with the verse's attempt. The dry run validated the schema.

smoke.after: For a fresh guest, /api/rate-limit-status reports generate-image 20 of 20. An automatic zero-credit request for John 1:1 got 402 (required 6, available 0, nothing charged). /john/1/1 answers 200. No chapter was painted: a real bulk run needs credits and the owner's budget.
smoke.beforeRelease: npm test 1708/1709 (thumbnail-backfill, untouched, flaky: passed on three reruns), tsc clean, eslint 0 errors, CI quality-gates green on 764599d2. Every new test failed before the fix. An independent agent review and CodeRabbit found nothing to change.

rollback.convex: Push the Convex functions from 1fec4365. Older pages ignore the extra attempt field, so this is only needed if the Convex change itself misbehaves.
